children: Costco Wholesale (COST, Financials), the warehouse retailer is expected to pay out about $7.5 billion in fiscal 2027 as it ramps up expansion after another successful quarter.

The company aims to open 33 warehouses in the fiscal year, including five relocations. That would get Costco closer to CEO Ron Vachris' longer-term objective of adding about 30 net new locations a year.
Costco finished fiscal 2026 with 939 warehouses and spent $6.4 billion on capital projects for the year.

The expansion is coupled with core business growth. Fourth quarter net sales were $93.87 billion, up 9.4 percent on a comparable sales basis. Net income was just under $3 billion, or $6.75 a diluted share.
Membership is still a big element of the equation. Costco ended the quarter with 42.3 million paid executive members, and reported a renewal rate of 92.3% in the U.S. and Canada.

The company is also expanding beyond warehouses. It's expanding its Uber Eats collaboration countrywide in the U.S. And it's also rolling out DoorDash delivery across the country. Management said sales through those channels have been mostly incremental, not sucking revenue away from warehouses.
Costco is likewise experiencing triple-digit rise in AI search traffic, but management said agentic commerce is still in its very early life.
Next up is Costco's fiscal 2027 expansion, specifically if its increased spending and new warehouse openings can support comparable-sales and membership growth.

title: Costco Just Unveiled a Massive $7.5 Billion Expansion Plan
